paragraphs.text:
The old man questions you about your visit. He seems almost 
suspicious. You can get out of the cab and get another, go to 58. Or 
you can answer the questions by going to 162. Or you can instruct 
the driver to be quiet and take you where you want: he will, and 
you’ll arrive at your destination. Go to any Athens Location.
(58)
